scope: 714 scans from 14 of 221 segments, spread across the whole run; full extraction needs 84 GiB

same_installation_as_sector_recordings.note: inside the spread of the five sector recordings; doubleT_obstacle remains the outlier

curvature.method: per-frame quadratic fit to the detector own rail anchors, every third frame, 237 frames
curvature.note: the old six recordings show no measurable curvature at all, so this regime is new

excursion_criterion_invalid_on_curves.criterion: center_stability flags |centre at 30 m| > 1 m, measured against the sensor axis
excursion_criterion_invalid_on_curves.why_it_breaks: a radius R puts the centre d^2/2R off axis legitimately, 1.1 m at 30 m on a 400 m curve
retracted: excursions reproduce on the extended recording
the learned offset transfers as an excursion detector to the extended recording
excursion_criterion_invalid_on_curves.still_valid: every section measured on the six sourcecraft recordings, where no curvature exists

arc_still_loses_to_tangent.note: the earlier refutation was limited to data without curves; it now holds where curves exist

neither_branch_models_curvature: main keeps a piecewise linear path; experiments/morev adds refine_rail_pair, described there as a local straight-line refinement and not a general curved-track estimator
limits: Subset, not the full recording. Curvature is fitted to the detector own anchors rather than an independent source. No labels: clusters are not alarms and not obstacles. Segment boundaries break event grouping, which biases candidate counts down.
